text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Rejoice, familiar!
Today I'm getting you another friend!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why am I in front of the station with Sweep Tosho on our day off?
The reason goes back about an hour—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Jeez, there you are, familiar! Come on, you're shopping with me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Because I only just found out today! 'Heal your heart with those cute eyes, the Magical Pooch plushie, on sale today!'

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It's a magical doggy!? I absolutely have to get one, so hurry up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, in order to find the plushie,
we headed to the nearest toy store, but—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Gah! What do you mean it's sold out!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, we can't just stand around dawdling!
Familiar, we're going to another store!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Sold out here too!?
Why!? Don't tell me you're hiding them from me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't here either...! 
Ugh, stop dragging your feet, Familiar! We're going to keep looking until we find one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, even after visiting every toy store we could think of,
the 'Magical Pooch' plushies were all sold out.
choice_data_list: If we can't find it even after all this, then...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why are you looking so glum!? I want it, so I'm not giving up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's your fault, Familiar! If you'd run at the same speed as me,
maybe we could've bought one before they sold out!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...I'm gonna find it, absolutely, positively!
Familiar, where's the next shop?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho throwing tantrums was nothing new,
but her unusual obstinacy caught my attention.
choice_data_list: Why do you want it so badly?
Why do you want it so badly?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I want it because I want it!
It has to be "Magical Doggy"!
choice_data_list: Is there something special about "Magical Doggy"?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yes! Because Grandma had one just like it...!

text_block_list.name: Grandmother's Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof, woof!

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text: Ugh... *sniffle* Don't come near me right now...

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Saying things you don't mean won't work on him.
I cast a spell on him, you see, so he knows what's in your heart.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
...What's that?
Sweepy's actually thinking, "I'm sorry, Papa"?

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I'm not!
I'm not sorry to Papa at all, you're totally wrong...

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text:
Totally wrong... but,
Grandma's magic really is amazing...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I want a doggy that understands feelings just like Grandma's!
But I can't have a real dog in the dorms, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna use "Magical Doggy" instead.
I'll cast a spell on "Magical Doggy" and—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If I turn it into a plushie that understands people's feelings,
then I'll become a real witch just like Grandma!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Sweep Tosho wanted the plushie
so she could take another step toward becoming like her idolized grandmother.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, the sun had set some time ago.
Running around all day might leave her exhausted tomorrow.
choice_data_list: It's getting late, so let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I said NO!
Why don't you get it?! If you wanna go home so badly, go by yourself!
choice_data_list: I'll look for it in your place!
I'll look for it in your place!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next morning, I waited for Sweep Tosho on her way to school and called out to her.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...What? Did you come to apologize?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
We searched all over yesterday and couldn't find it.
I bet you didn't find it either, did you?!
choice_data_list: Well then, riddle me this: what's this right here?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, what's—huh...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To a stunned Sweep Tosho, I handed over the promised present.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Is this... 'Magical Doggie'?! You really found it?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it wasn't anywhere...!
I was sure it was completely impossible...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, "Magical Doggo" was extremely popular,
and I only managed to secure one after calling stores in neighboring prefectures.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Even though you sent me home first...
you really kept looking after that?!
choice_data_list: Because you need it to become a splendid witch.
Because you need it to become a splendid witch.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: For me to... become a witch...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying "to become a witch" might sound like a leap,
but I did it in hopes of giving her a push toward her dream.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahhh! W-Well, fine!
If you're begging me that much, I'll take care of you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I mean... really!
It's only natural for a familiar to work for their master, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Even if you hadn't found it,
I'm sure I would've found and bought it myself anyway!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Your Trainer helped you with this, right?
Make sure you thank them properly later!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, I don't know what you're talking about!
I didn't ask for this. My familiar just did it on its own!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiars are so weird... don't you think so too, puppy?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ............What's with that look?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's not it!
I'm not actually grateful or anything, you're way off base!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Forget it! You need to learn how to read minds better, seriously!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Despite her complaints, Sweep Tosho hugged her 'Magical Puppy' tight and crawled into bed.
